title: Chinese physical AI startup Simplexity Robotics raised a $100M pre-Series A led by Ant Group, with Alibaba, Tencent, and others joining, at a $1.6B valuation
html:
This is a Techmeme archive page. It shows how the site appeared at 2:01 AM ET, November 23, 2026.

summary: The Chinese physical-AI startup’s round also drew Alibaba, Tencent and others, per Techmeme’s summary of the report.
